title: Liz Barber FCA GAICD (ASX100 Risk & Transformation Executive) — 'Everything worth protecting will eventually need protection'
summary: Australian ASX100 risk-and-transformation executive Liz Barber (FCA GAICD) writes a three-part framework post on Incorruptible: Corporate Governance as Strategy, Success as Gravity, Drift Is Never One Decision. Two book pull quotes anchor the piece — the case for governance as a creative act, not a compliance checkbox.
blockquote: Governance is a creative act, not a compliance checkbox; the strategic work of deciding, in advance, what your company will never trade away. Build something worth protecting, then build the structure that protects it, 'everything worth protecting will eventually need protection.'
blockquote_source: Liz Barber on LinkedIn, quoting Incorruptible
